chlorine.iteration 1: no caustics: per-wave Hessian gain is ~0.03 where folds need 0.4-0.6, so it reads as a still diagram of a pool with a wobbly line
chlorine.v1: the leaf was the lone drifter; the revision swaps it for a red float with a Snell-offset shadow that rocks when the drip ring passes
chlorine.final: ring, hole and offset shadow read at true scale; ~60 px of red against ~4,500 px of water keeps teal dominant and the door light muted

laps.iteration 1: the fish is a bun: two ellipsoids read as a potato with a dark marble behind it, and the frame is underexposed at void 84%
laps.v1: the radial table pool made a hard shadow wedge clipped at 16 cm though the tip reaches 25 cm; v2 projects the window onto the table instead
laps.final: the window is projected onto the table; the caustic crescent and soft bowl shadow sit inside the patch, and void rises from 57% to 64%

sodium.iteration 1: underlit by ~5x: wall irradiance 0.22 times albedo 0.55 gives tone 0.15, so walls, arch and road are near-black blobs at void 75%
sodium.v1: lamp pairs at t=0 read as a face, bare walls gave the light nothing to catch, and the 28 m car's 0.6 px lights could not anchor the frame
sodium.final: ribbed arch, lit trim line and tile courses run to the vanishing point over deep black (void 79%); a car 14 m ahead anchors the frame

eastbound.iteration 1: the plane never leaves the frame: its path ends at row 37 and it teleports back on the wrap, leaving only a short trail stub low down
eastbound.final: the contrail's gold-to-crimson is the real transmittance of the grazing sun ray, i.e. Earth's penumbra moving across the line

insomnia.iteration 1: the geometry, not the render: a lamp 9 m to the side and 1.6 m below the floor grazes the ceiling, so the window becomes a 3 m amber streak
insomnia.final: t=0 is a V: the amber window cross leans left, the cold white car sweep leans right, both springing from the real window at the glass

seeing.iteration 1: the blur swallows the planet: sigma up to 2.8 px turns Saturn into a cream blob, and the short-wavelength swim tears the ring edges
seeing.final: t=0 is the steady moment: dim warm Saturn with the Cassini division, ring shadow and moons in a soft glow on a void of 87%

hollow.iteration 1: no eyes, no nose: the triangle SDF sign was flipped, the mouth sat at the pumpkin's bottom edge, and the floor was a flat grey plane
hollow.final: the grin on the boards is traced back through the carved openings from the flame; two upper teeth read as a toothy grin, not a bat

wake.iteration 1: tone: cores clip to flat neon lime, so the spiral structure, the point of the piece, vanishes inside saturated blobs
wake.final: four green scrolls climb from a dye-coated rod with a blue laser crescent; Re 145, T 24 s, quadrant glyphs halve the shear-layer width

airshaft.iteration 1: it reads as a corridor, not a shaft: the 24 degree tilt makes the north wall a receding floor and the sky a flat lit doorway
airshaft.v1: ~44 random lit windows over textured-dark walls (void 26%) did not read at phone size; v2 places 6 windows and adds corner and slab edges
airshaft.final: four corner edges make an X into the amber opening and the storey lines step down to it; void 62%, and it reads as looking up

hush.iteration 1: the ground is a flat cream slab, the post shadow a hard black bar, and the flakes are 2-px dashes that read as rain
hush.v1: every flake was a 1-px square of one size, so the swarm read as embers, not snow; v2 adds near, mid and far populations and a cool ambient
hush.final: three flake populations tied to depth, cool ambient specks and snow caps make it snow, while the amber still reads as the lamp's light
